The formula Mg3Si4H2O12 suggests there are 4 silicon atoms (Si) in one formula unit of talc. The silicate anion formula is given as [SixO10]^{4-}, indicating that the silicate structure contributes to this anion. Since there are 4 silicon atoms in the formula of talc, and we are to find x for the silicate unit, it is reasonable to equate 4 to the sum of silicon atoms in the silicate anion present in the formula.
